artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed architectural scene featuring a group of people in period clothing. The composition displays numerous figures adorned in ornate historical attire around a grand architectural setting with soaring arches and decorative columns. The figures appear engaged in a scene within a structured, interior space. The drawing emphasizes intricate line work and shading to convey depth and texture within the stonework and clothing.

artworks.title: Monsieur and Madame Blizet with Monsieur Le Roy the Actor
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over red and black chalks with touches of graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Carter Stevenson in memory of Sir Geoffrey Agnew
artworks.description: The image contains three individuals. The first person, a man, is playing a violin on the left side. The second person, a woman, is seated in the center wearing a decorated gown and holding a fan. The third person, another man, is seated on the right. The setting appears to be a classical or baroque-style room with a large column to the right and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Poppy in Bloom
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of large, leafy plants with intricately drawn foliage. The color scheme is sepia tones on a cream background. The largest cluster of leaves is at the lower half, with a smaller cluster on the right side.

artworks.title: Poppy in Bloom
artworks.medium: red chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows intricate leaf patterns in a reddish-brown tone on a light background. The design features large foliage with tendrils and stems extending outward, creating a sense of organic movement.

artworks.title: Poppies with Seed Pods
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of several poppy plants with flowers and seed heads. The color palette is primarily soft sepia tones, creating a monochromatic appearance. The poppy plants are depicted vertically in the center of the image, with leaves spreading outward and flowers and seed heads reaching in different directions. They occupy most of the composition against a light background.

artworks.title: Flowering Plant with Grass
artworks.medium: red chalk with wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of tall plants with elongated leaves and clusters of small flowers at the top, all rendered in a single brownish-red color. The monochrome palette primarily consists of varying shades of brownish-red, giving the drawing a vintage, sepia-toned look. The plants are centrally positioned, filling most of the frame, with their leaves and stems stretching outward. The flowers and leaves create a textured and layered appearance against a light, blank background.

artworks.title: Flowering Plant with Buds
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a leafy plant with large, textured leaves in a sepia tone. The plant is centered in the composition, with faint outlines of additional foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Pont Aberglaslyn
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a waterfall flowing under a stone bridge. On the bridge, there are two figures on horseback and one standing. The brushstrokes are soft, resembling watercolor. In the background, there are tall mountains fading into misty clouds. The color scheme consists of earth tones, blues, and grays.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Standing Lady
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch displaying a person standing in an upright position. The person has curly hair, defined facial features, and is wearing an elaborate dress. The background features an outdoor setting with classical architectural elements and foliage.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Standing Lady
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a person standing in an elegant pose. The figure leans against a round table with both hands placed on it. The face has minimal detail, with slight emphasis on the eyes and mouth. The hair is styled in an updo. The person wears a flowing gown with intricate details on the sleeves and bodice, with buttons and a defined waistline. A cloak drapes from the shoulders to the floor. The table holds an unspecified object. In the background, there are abstract shapes indicating a curtain on the left and foliage, implying an interior setting with a hint of the outdoors.

artworks.title: Aerial View of Theatre
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate theatrical stage or arena. It features an enclosed space with high walls adorned with numerous sculptures and decorative elements, multiple tiers of seating ascending the walls on both sides, and a large horse-drawn chariot in the center. Figures and additional horses are dispersed throughout the scene. The architecture includes ornately detailed structures topped with crowns and eagles, suggesting a regal or imperial theme. The precision of line work and detailed ornamentation is reminiscent of baroque aesthetics.

artworks.title: The Rock of Aeolus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 31.4 x 22.6 cm (12 3/8 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features jagged and irregular lines forming an abstract representation of a towering rock or mountain. At the summit, there are human-like figures gathered around. Above them, on a pedestal, a grand figure with a scepter appears to be overseeing the scene, with rays extending downward. On either side, abstract forms suggest faces. Several winged figures are soaring through the air. The structure below includes rocky outcrops and steps carved into its surface.

artworks.title: Twenty-Four Cavorting Cavaliers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of horses adorned with elaborate headdresses. The artwork features two rows of horses with ornate plumes on their heads. The horses appear to be elegantly prancing or trotting, each captured with intricate detail to suggest movement and grace. The upper row consists of a curved line of horses, while the lower row mirrors this arrangement, creating symmetry in the composition. The background is stark and minimal, drawing attention to the detailed renderings of the horses. The space between the rows is open, bringing focus to the linear arrangement and design elements.

artworks.title: Fighting Cavaliers
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.7 x 31.3 cm (8 15/16 x 12 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts several horseback figures in various poses. The artwork shows multiple depictions of horse riders engaged in different dynamic actions spread out across the canvas. The figures are illustrated with a focus on movement, some appearing to be in combat while others display equestrian maneuvers with riders holding lances or other weaponry. The drawing is detailed in the riders' attire and the form of the horses, conveying a sense of motion and intensity in each small vignette against a plain background.

artworks.title: Twenty-Four Cavaliers in an Oval
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.2 x 31.6 cm (8 3/4 x 12 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses with ornamental riders arranged in a formation. The image shows multiple horses, each adorned with a rider wearing elaborate, plumed headdresses. The riders hold different poses and seem to be part of a coordinated display or parade. The arrangement forms an organized pattern on the ground. The drawing captures the horses in motion, with detailed riders' attire, giving the impression of a ceremonial or festive event. The overall composition is symmetrical and dynamic.

artworks.title: Cavaliers Fighting with Swords
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.5 x 31.1 cm (9 1/4 x 12 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of horses with feathered headdresses. The image shows two rows of horses wearing decorative plumage on their heads. The horses are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting movement and elegance. The composition is symmetric, with six horses in each row arranged in a coordinated manner. The drawing style emphasizes detail and movement, conveying a sense of nobility and ceremonial pageantry.

artworks.title: Twenty-Four Cavaliers in Double S Formation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in a dynamic formation. The artwork depicts multiple horses spread across the canvas in a scattered yet organized manner. Each horse is intricately detailed, with flowing manes suggesting a sense of motion. The background is minimal, which emphasizes the lively motion of the horses and provides a sense of spaciousness. The sketchy quality of the lines conveys movement and vitality, as the horses appear in varied postures across the expanse of the canvas.

artworks.title: Cavaliers Fighting in Two Columns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of pairs of horsemen engaged in dynamic interactions. The drawing features two columns of horse and rider pairs on either side. Each rider is adorned with elaborate attire, including plumed helmets and ornate clothing. The action depicted shows the riders in various postures, performing choreography or specialized maneuvers. This drawing is in the style of Jacques Callot.

artworks.title: Ten Cavaliers with Large Plumed Helmets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formation of horses and riders. Eight horses are shown in a symmetrical arrangement, all standing upright on their hind legs. Each horse is adorned with decorations, including feathers. Two figures stand in the center and wear decorative costumes like the riders. The composition is sparse with negative space, highlighting the pattern and symmetry. The drawing captures the grandeur and pageantry of the subjects with detailed finesse.

artworks.title: Ten Cavaliers in a Circle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a symmetrical arrangement of horses performing a maneuver. The image features a series of identical illustrations of horses, each rearing up with a plume, positioned in a circular arrangement. The horses are evenly spaced around the circle, creating a sense of movement and rhythm in the composition. The uniformity and repetition of the figures suggest a disciplined and organized equestrian display. The simple lines and minimal background highlight the central focus on the horse figures themselves.

artworks.title: A Procession of Sixty Cavaliers and Torch Bearers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large formation of marching figures and horses. The drawing depicts an organized assembly of small figures arranged in rows and columns, with some figures on horseback and others on foot. The detail captures a dynamic movement from left to right across the paper, with some figures holding long staffs or banners, and many adorned with plumes or crests. The composition illustrates the discipline and precision of a ceremonial or military parade on a pale background. The lines are delicate, emphasizing the uniformity and grandeur of the formation.

artworks.title: Thirty-Six Jugglers Standing in Pyramids
artworks.description: This is a drawing of six acrobatic formations. The drawing depicts six groups arranged in two vertical columns, showing human figures creatively stacked in pyramidal shapes. Each group is performing a balancing act, with each figure holding a flaming torch aloft. The sketch is detailed, with careful attention to the positioning and gestures of the figures, capturing a sense of dynamic energy and motion. The lines are fine and softly textured, contributing to an overall delicate yet lively composition.

artworks.title: Pyramids of Jugglers
artworks.description: The image shows five human pyramids in different configurations, with figures stacked upon each other in various ways. The figures are holding torches, adding movement to the structures. The pyramids are spread out evenly on the canvas, showcasing diverse compositions. Lines and shading create depth and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: Early Morning
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and graphite with touches of white gouache on laid paper, with border line in black ink drawn by the artist
artworks.dimensions:
overall (sheet): 32.4 x 24.7 cm (12 3/4 x 9 3/4 in.)
image (to border line): 28.8 x 21.8 cm (11 5/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in a lavishly decorated room. The first person, a man, is seated on a chair. He has a composed expression and wears 18th-century attire. To his side stands a woman wearing an elegant dress. Another woman stands closer to a large mirror. The room is ornately decorated with heavy drapery, a large mirror, a decorative oval panel on the wall, and a candelabrum.
